INTERNAL_SYSTEM_PASS.note: This is a useful milestone but NOT evidence that an independent external organization would call all 15 'world-class.'

EXTERNAL_CONSULTANT_PASS.description: An independent expert evaluates the dossier from scratch, without trusting the developer's summary.
EXTERNAL_CONSULTANT_PASS.independence: FULL — consultant reads only the actual current transfer package
EXTERNAL_CONSULTANT_PASS.current_state: NOT YET ADMINISTERED — consultant must re-audit the current 15

REAL_MARKET_PASS.description: A real buyer allocates resources, requests diligence, funds validation, or negotiates.
REAL_MARKET_PASS.note: This requires actual market engagement. No software can substitute for it.
